root.label: ABC Trading squishy dumpling toy recall

events.label: ABC Trading squishy dumpling toy recall

slots.name: recalled quantity
slots.sentence: ABC Trading recalled 37,000 Squishy Dumpling Toys and Crazy Squib Ball Toys sold at ABC Trading stores in Los Angeles and other stores nationwide from April through June 2026 for between 41 cents and $1.25.

slots.name: injuries reported
slots.sentence: No injuries has been reported for either recalled toy, as of Oct. 1.

slots.name: dumpling toy model number
slots.sentence: The model number for the dumpling toy is "3655", according to the recall report.

slots.name: squib ball model number
slots.sentence: The model number for the crazy squib balls is "3984," according to the recall report.
